en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a tall monument with a female figure holding three stars atop a column. Several statues are at the base, and people are seen standing and walking around the monument. There are older European-style buildings in the background. The border of the postcard has a scalloped edge. The bottom of the postcard has text in both Latvian and French.
